assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: portrait mobile sci-fi toy mecha game hangar background, production art with no text and no characters. Stylized polished painted 3D game illustration, friendly toy-mecha proportions, visually restrained not grim photorealism. Portrait 2:3 composition: upper 20 percent is quiet dark navy architecture for title typography; middle center has an EMPTY circular deployment platform at around 58 percent height where a transparent mech character will be composited by code, symmetrical side service arms parked out of the center, a luminous thin cyan energy ring in the platform; lower 32 percent dark calm negative space for menu controls, not a busy floor. Center area must remain unoccupied. No weapons, robots, people, text, logos, glyphs, UI buttons, frames, HUD, watermark, or baked fake interface. Full bleed opaque background.
